zones.assembly: Long faceted pressure hull, low office cabin with sealed warm windows, proud access roof and connected sensor mast.
zones.bill: Welded alloy pressure hull in warm ivory lacquer, graphite replaceable roof courses, cobalt livery band. Window apertures have dark coamings and narrow warm glass; no office box floating on a tube.

zones.assembly: Shorter wide pressure pontoon with recessed work deck, enclosed hatch rims and six large captive tool assemblies.
zones.bill: Ivory alloy case, dark well floor, gray tools and cobalt stripe. Each tool sits in a cradle or mount; no pile of unrelated primitives or micro-greeble carpet.

zones.assembly: Unequal short pressure pontoon, arm foundation, ribbed power/service covers and supported aft bell.
zones.bill: Warm ivory shell with dark service bays and cobalt identity course. Raised covers imply removable hardware; orange belongs only to the service arm/hazard points.

zones.assembly: Exactly two narrow load-bearing crossbeams span the three hulls; folded outer caps, dark underside and continuous service ducts.
zones.bill: Gray welded box-section bridges with bevelled plate edges and seated cobalt upper cap. Long gaps remain empty between crossbeams. No invisible full-width slab.

zones.assembly: Seated base bearing, twin upper clevis rails, raised elbow pin, folded forearm and two independently supported grip jaws.
zones.bill: Orange standardized hazard coating on load links, gray bearings/jaws and dark clearances. All links remain connected through nested pivots. No floating robot arm, field custody or invented demonstration forces.

zones.assembly: Three seated recessed bell throats, small port/starboard lamps and a mast beacon above the real office.
zones.bill: Dark heat shields and small recessed emissive cores; tiny cased navigation/window lamps show human occupation. No neon perimeter, broad luminous disks or bloom wash.
